children: is scheduled to report its fiscal third-quarter 2026 results on Monday, November 16, before the market opens.
of $0.92 per share on revenue of $4.59B, with investors looking for signs that growth in AI and cloud businesses can offset continued weakness in its core advertising operations.
The concerns over China's slowing economy, declining search advertising revenue, and intensifying AI competition have weighed on sentiment.
Estimate revisions also point to caution, with 11 downward EPS revisions and seven downward revenue revisions over the past three months, against six upward revenue revisions.
A key metric to watch will be online marketing revenue, which has faced structural pressure from weaker advertiser spending and competition from AI-powered platforms.
Astrada Advisors expects the segment to decline 15%–20% YoY in the third quarter, citing China's challenging macroeconomic environment and traffic dilution from competing AI applications.
